trailhead.label: Malga Ra Stua, where the shuttle bus from Fiames stops

cautions: High, open karst plateau at 2,100–2,330 m with almost no shade: storms build quickly on summer afternoons.
Stony, rocky path on the descent past the lakes.
Cows graze around Malga Ra Stua and Cianpo de Crósc in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
